real_finding_bind_mount_mmap: Bind-mounting xbrl.duckdb directly from the Windows host into the Linux container caused DuckDB IOException ('Cannot allocate memory') on open, despite the same file being freely readable via plain file I/O through the identical bind mount and 15.1 GB being available to the Docker Desktop VM - isolated to DuckDB's memory-mapped access pattern hitting a Docker-Desktop-for-Windows bind-mount limitation. Copying the file into a native Docker volume fixed it immediately. Documented as evidence favoring EFS (not a literal bind mount) for a real cloud deployment.
